posts.title: Fit in Six Weeks
posts.description: It's the start of the six-week summer holiday for schools in the UK. I'm a teacher, so have this time off! I've been reasonably fit most of my life (wear-and-tear aside), due to a generally active lifestyle. posts.title: (Fair-weather) Cycling
posts.description: Went out for a ride today (first of the year)! This is my rig: It's a Norco hybrid that I bought new around 2010. It needs some maintenance! Ride was good. Enjoyed the sun and took it easy. Went to town (solo), had some beans on toast, cake and a macchiato. Lots of hills where we live. Did 10-12 miles. Hoping to get out for some more fair-weather cycling this week! ___ Written by a human; not AI F
